screen.budget: Archived 50 pretrain, 200 maximum finetune, patience 30 (strict calibration AP), matched 10th epoch secondary comparison. Same number of draws per epoch; uniform replacement for loss_only.

selection.prefix: Always retain after invariance and gradient tests. Corrects support of history objective and encoding.
selection.weighting: Compare the two finite alternatives to double weighting. Retain highest best-checkpoint calibration AP only if higher than double, finite optimization and epoch-10 calibration AP no lower than double. Otherwise retain double. Ties prefer original then sample_only.
selection.sparse: Retain if it improves exact zero specificity on teacher-dominant positive measured calibration CT, has nonzero sensitivity on actually positive non-dominant or growing sites, and calibration AP is within 0.003 absolute of C0 or better. Otherwise retain dense output and report the sparse control.
selection.combination: No combination search. One choice. Freeze JSON before any new evaluation predictions.

validation.decision: Internal development only. Historical baseline goal delta >=0.003 and simultaneous lower bound >0 versus all nine. Independently assess diffusion via R-N. End after this validation.
